prefix.before: Cluster::new() builds OmniPaxos<Value, MemoryStorage<Value>> for pids 1,2,3 (validated OmniPaxosConfig). run_prefix(): node 3 calls try_become_leader(); the FIFO pump drains Prepare/Promise/AcceptSync/Accepted until quiet (SAMPLE phase leader_elected); node 3 appends Value(0..4) and the pump drains AcceptDecide/Accepted/Decide until quiet (phase entries_decided); node 3 calls reconfigure(ClusterConfig{configuration_id: 2, nodes:[1,2,3]}, None) and the pump drains AcceptStopSign/Accepted/Decide until quiet (phase stopsign_decided). Case resync then calls node1.reconnected(3) and node2.reconnected(3) and pumps to quiet; case control only pumps again. Each SAMPLE line reports node, accepted_idx (get_accepted_idx), decided_idx (get_decided_idx), decided_eq_accepted, is_reconfigured(), read(5), and read_decided_suffix(0) (state plus entry count).

Case resync calls node1.reconnected(3) and node2.reconnected(3); case single calls only node1.reconnected(3); case control calls neither; every case then drains the FIFO queue to quiet and samples nodes 1, 2 and 3.
